nameOfQualification: Associate cum Coordinator - Early Child Development (ECD) Services
description: Associate-cum-Coordinator is a professional responsible for overseeing the implementation, and quality of ECD curriculum and services. The role of the professional is to focus on management, mentoring, monitoring, and ensuring standards in early childhood services. This is in contrast with the role of the worker who directly interacts with children on a daily basis. However, they would work closely with leadership, parents, community and other stakeholders. The course will provide expertise in a wide range of areas, including team coordination, implementation of age-appropriate learning activities, health and safety standards, financial oversight, inventory management, records management while ensuring safety and compliance with legal requirements and ensuring inclusivity for children with developmental delays or disabilities. By completing this course, participants will be equipped to work in early childhood care, learning, and development centers with confidence, morality, creating a nurturing, efficient, and legally compliant environment that supports the growth and well-being of every child including children with disabilities and sick children with protection from child abuse and neglect.
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Entrepreneurship

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Recognize the significance of Early Child Development (ECD) & its management systems
Implement and monitor an age and developmentally appropriate childcare program in an early childhood care, learning, and development center
Implement and monitor nutritional, health, and safety requirements for children according to their developmental milestones to ensure overall wellness
Manage daily operations of the center while supporting staff and parents in the child's development
Identify developmental delays, disabilities or impairments in children for early detection and implement inclusive interventions.
